mapper.select: select distinct r.id from user_invoice_processing p join user_invoice_application a on a.id=p.application_id join user_invoice_application_order o on o.application_id=a.id and o.active_key=1 and o.order_source='registration' join cms_registration r on r.id=o.order_id where r.id > #{after} and a.status in ('SUBMITTED','CLAIMED','PROCESSING','ISSUE_UNKNOWN','ISSUED') and not (a.status='ISSUED' and p.reconciliation_status='TAX_REVIEW_REQUIRED') and (r.payment_status is null or r.payment_status<>2 or r.registration_status is null or r.registration_status<>2 or exists (select 1 from cms_registration child where r.parent_order_no is not null and r.parent_order_no!='' and child.parent_order_no=r.parent_order_no and (child.payment_status is null or child.payment_status<>2 or child.registration_status is null or child.registration_status<>2)) or exists (select 1 from refund_application ra where ra.source_type='registration' and ra.del_flag=0 and (ra.status is null or ra.status<>2) and (ra.source_id=r.id or exists (select 1 from cms_registration sibling where r.parent_order_no is not null and r.parent_order_no!='' and sibling.parent_order_no=r.parent_order_no and sibling.id=ra.source_id)))) order by r.id limit 50
mapper.sql: join user_invoice_issuer i on i.id=p.issuer_id and i.enabled=1 join user_invoice_scope s on s.issuer_id=i.id and s.user_id=#{actor} and s.enabled=1 join sys_user u on u.user_id=s.user_id and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' join user_invoice_scope q on q.issuer_id=i.id and q.user_id=i.reconciliation_user_id and q.enabled=1 and q.can_reconcile=1 join sys_user qu on qu.user_id=q.user_id and qu.status='0' and qu.del_flag='0'
exists (select 1 from user_invoice_scope h join sys_user hu on hu.user_id=h.user_id and hu.status='0' and hu.del_flag='0' where h.issuer_id=i.id and h.enabled=1 and h.can_handle=1)
mapper.select: select p.application_id from user_invoice_processing p where (s.can_handle=1 or (s.can_reconcile=1 and s.user_id=i.reconciliation_user_id)) and and p.application_id < #{before} order by p.application_id desc limit 50

select p.*, s.can_handle, s.can_reconcile, i.reconciliation_user_id, i.issuer_name from user_invoice_processing p where p.application_id=#{id} and and (s.can_handle=1 or (s.can_reconcile=1 and s.user_id=i.reconciliation_user_id))

select p.*, s.can_handle, s.can_reconcile, i.reconciliation_user_id, i.issuer_name from user_invoice_processing p where p.application_id=#{id} and and (s.can_handle=1 or (s.can_reconcile=1 and s.user_id=i.reconciliation_user_id)) for share
select * from user_invoice_processing where application_id=#{id} for update
select * from user_invoice_application where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update user_invoice_application set status=#{to}, update_time=now(), invoice_no=coalesce(#{invoiceNo},invoice_no), reject_reason=coalesce(#{reason},reject_reason), issued_at=case when #{to}='ISSUED' then now() else issued_at end where id=#{id} and status=#{from}
mapper.select: select action,fingerprint,result_status,result_version,evidence_ref from user_invoice_processing_audit where application_id=#{id} and actor_id=#{actor} and request_id=#{request} for share
select distinct application_id from user_invoice_application_order where active_key=1 and order_source='registration' and order_id in #{r} order by application_id
